write-consoletext.title: write-consoletext.ps1
write-consoletext.label: write-consoletext in Windows PowerShell 5.1

frame.dark: Deploying FS01 to Production √ copied 1,204 files Status: healthy Collecting inventory ................... done Release 2026.10 is live

write-consoletext.script:
Write-ConsoleText -Text 'Deploying ', 'FS01', ' to ', 'Production' -Color Gray, Cyan, Gray, Yellow
Write-ConsoleText -Markup '[pass]√[/] copied 1,204 files' -StartTab 1
Write-ConsoleText -Text 'Status: ', 'healthy' -Color DarkGray, Green -StartSpaces 8
Write-ConsoleText -Text 'Collecting inventory ' -Color Gray -PadRight 40 -PadCharacter '.' -NoNewLine
Write-ConsoleText -Text ' done' -Color Green
Write-ConsoleText -Text 'Release 2026.10 is live' -Gradient '#38bdf8', '#c084fc' -HorizontalCenter

job-ps5.title: job.ps1
job-ps5.label: job in Windows PowerShell 5.1

frame.dark: From a background job ╭───────┬────────╮ │ Check │ Status │ ├───────┼────────┤ │ SPF │ ✓ Pass │ │ DMARC │ ✗ Fail │ ╰───────┴────────╯

job-ps5.script:
$module = (Get-Module ConsoleMonster).Path
Start-Job -ArgumentList $module {
    param($Module)
    Import-Module $Module
    [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'SPF'; Status = 'Pass' }, [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'DMARC'; Status = 'Fail' } |
        Write-ConsoleTable -Title 'From a background job' -StatusProperty Status
} | Receive-Job -Wait -AutoRemoveJob
